shared_elements: schematic quadruped animal shown in profile
row/register of animal figures along the upper part of the surface
figures carved in low relief/incision on a flat rectangular block face
linear framing or banding dividing the field
justification: Both surfaces place small, highly schematic profile animals in a row across the top of a flat rectangular block, with further motifs below and linear framing/banding organising the field, which is a genuine if fairly generic correspondence in register-based animal iconography. The decisive difference is the content below: B is dominated by a single large whirling multi-armed disc/rosette with no counterpart in A, while A carries dense bands of repeated arched and hatched motifs plus larger creeping quadrupeds and no circular emblem at all.
